name: SimplePractice vs TheraNest
title: SimplePractice vs TheraNest: EHR Comparison for Therapists (2026)
description: Compare SimplePractice and TheraNest for mental health practices. See differences in pricing, features, telehealth, billing, and which EHR is best for solo vs group practices.

summary.bottom_line: SimplePractice offers a more modern interface with e-prescribing and broader integrations—ideal for solo practitioners who want polish and convenience. TheraNest (now under Ensora Mental Health) provides competitive pricing for group practices and strong core EHR features, though some users report the interface feels dated.

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs TheraNest: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice and TheraNest are both established EHR platforms for mental health professionals. SimplePractice is known for its modern interface and client portal—over 225,000 clinicians use it. TheraNest, now part of Therapy Brands (Ensora Mental Health), offers solid core EHR functionality at competitive prices. Both handle scheduling, documentation, billing, and telehealth, but they differ in polish, pricing structure, and advanced features.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: TheraNest often has lower entry pricing for solo practitioners (around $39/month vs SimplePractice's $49/month Starter). For group practices, the math depends on your size—TheraNest uses volume-based tiers while SimplePractice charges $74 per additional clinician. Run the numbers for your specific practice size. Note: SimplePractice raised prices in recent years, which has pushed some users to explore alternatives like TheraNest.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: The key differentiator is e-prescribing: SimplePractice offers it as an add-on ($49/mo) while TheraNest does not currently support e-prescribing. For prescribers, this makes SimplePractice the obvious choice. SimplePractice also has broader calendar integrations (including Outlook) and a more modern interface. TheraNest's interface is functional but often described as dated. Both offer telehealth, though SimplePractice supports larger group sessions (up to 15 participants).

sections.heading: Company & Ownership
sections.content: SimplePractice remains an independent company. TheraNest was acquired by Therapy Brands (now Ensora Mental Health), which also owns MyClientsPlus, Procentive, and other behavioral health tools. Some users have concerns about platform consolidation and potential future changes under corporate ownership. Others see the Ensora ecosystem as a benefit with potential for tighter integrations across products.

recommendations.when: You're a prescriber who needs e-prescribing, you value modern interface design and client portal experience, you want Outlook calendar integration, or you need group telehealth with multiple participants

You're a non-prescribing therapist on a budget, you have a larger group practice where TheraNest's volume pricing is more economical, you want solid core EHR without paying for premium polish, or you're already in the Therapy Brands/Ensora ecosystem
You want 24/7 support and purpose-built behavioral health templates—TherapyNotes often wins on support quality

faqs.a: TheraNest typically has lower entry-level pricing (around $39/month vs SimplePractice's $49/month). However, the cost comparison depends on your practice size and needed features. SimplePractice charges $74/additional clinician for group practices. Run the full cost calculation for your specific situation.

faqs.q: Does TheraNest have e-prescribing like SimplePractice?
faqs.a: No. TheraNest does not currently offer e-prescribing. SimplePractice offers e-prescribing as an add-on ($49/month plus $89 setup fee). If you're a prescriber, this is a significant differentiator favoring SimplePractice.

TheraNest was acquired by Therapy Brands, which has rebranded as Ensora Mental Health. The same company owns MyClientsPlus, Procentive, and other behavioral health platforms. SimplePractice remains independently owned.

faqs.q: Which has better telehealth: SimplePractice or TheraNest?
faqs.a: Both offer HIPAA-compliant telehealth. SimplePractice supports group sessions with up to 15 participants and has broader video features. TheraNest's telehealth is solid for 1:1 sessions but has fewer advanced capabilities. For group therapy sessions, SimplePractice has the advantage.
